cryo_debtor.name: Cryo-Debtor
cryo_debtor.desc: Frozen as collateral for a loan you don't remember taking. Interest kept compounding while you slept.
cryo_debtor.story: You were put on ice by Halcyon Debt & Trust as 'living collateral'.

ex_auditor.name: Ex-Corporate Auditor
ex_auditor.desc: You found one number too many in a Consortium ledger. They froze the number. And you.
ex_auditor.story: As a Consortium auditor you found the wrong decimal point, and the decimal point found you.

asteroid_miner.name: Asteroid Miner
asteroid_miner.desc: Twelve years cracking rocks for Gristle. Your lungs are 30% dust and 70% spite.
asteroid_miner.story: You spent a decade mining asteroids on a contract that paid in 'exposure to vacuum'.

jingle_composer.name: Disgraced Jingle Composer
jingle_composer.desc: You wrote the OxyGenix breathing jingle. Then you wrote the parody. Lumen owns both.
jingle_composer.story: You wrote a jingle so catchy it was classified as a mind-control device, then a parody so honest it was classified as terrorism.

street_medic.name: Street Medic
street_medic.desc: Patched up workers the Consortium's insurance wouldn't. They called it 'unlicensed compassion'.
street_medic.story: You ran a back-alley clinic for people who couldn't afford to bleed.

clone_reject.name: Clone Reject #4471
clone_reject.desc: A factory-recalled clone. Slight defect: free will. Your warranty expired before you did.
clone_reject.story: You were a recalled clone, binned for the manufacturing defect known as 'having opinions'.

pay_debt.name: Pay Off The Debt
pay_debt.desc: Clear your Halcyon debt and walk free. Probably. Read the fine print.
pay_debt.story: Now you want one thing: a zero balance.

burn_consortium.name: Burn The Consortium
burn_consortium.desc: Five companies own the stars. You own a grudge and a second-hand blaster.
burn_consortium.story: Now you want to watch the Consortium's stock price hit absolute zero.

find_sibling.name: Find Your Sibling
find_sibling.desc: Your twin was sold to a different cryo-vault. The receipt is the only family photo you have.
find_sibling.story: Now you want to find the sibling who was frozen in the vault next door, then sold separately.

get_famous.name: Become A Celebrity
get_famous.desc: Lumen will put anyone on the feed if they're interesting enough. You plan to be very interesting.
get_famous.story: Now you want your face on every billboard in the Sprawl, preferably not on a WANTED poster.

buy_a_planet.name: Buy A Planet
buy_a_planet.desc: If you can't beat the Consortium, become a tiny, independent, deeply suspicious sixth member.
buy_a_planet.story: Now you want to buy a planet of your own, and charge everyone for the air.

wanted_alias.name: Wanted Under Another Name
wanted_alias.desc: Paragon has a bounty on a face that looks exactly like yours. Because it is yours.
wanted_alias.story: Your secret: Paragon still has an open warrant on your old name.

synth_air_allergy.name: Allergic To Synthetic Air
synth_air_allergy.desc: OxyGenix air gives you hives. Premium organic air costs triple. Breathe sparingly.
synth_air_allergy.story: Your secret: you're allergic to the only air you can afford.

compulsive_liar.name: Compulsive Liar
compulsive_liar.desc: You lie when you're nervous. You're nervous when you breathe. Bluffs work great until they don't.
compulsive_liar.story: Your secret: you can't stop lying, and you're very, very good at it.

sleeper_agent.name: Corporate Sleeper Agent
sleeper_agent.desc: Somewhere in your head is a trigger phrase. You don't know which company installed it. Neither does QUACK.
sleeper_agent.story: Your secret: someone installed a sleeper protocol in your brain, and it is still asleep. Mostly.

kleptomaniac.name: Kleptomaniac
kleptomaniac.desc: Your hands file paperwork without asking your brain. Things just end up in your pockets.
kleptomaniac.story: Your secret: things simply migrate into your pockets.

synergies.name: Whistleblower
synergies.text: Synergy WHISTLEBLOWER: you know exactly which ledgers to burn.

synergies.name: Repayment Plan
synergies.text: Synergy REPAYMENT PLAN: Halcyon's interest rate on you is merely predatory instead of apocalyptic.

synergies.name: One-Hit Wonder
synergies.text: Synergy ONE-HIT WONDER: people hum your jingle while reporting your crimes, which slows them down.

synergies.name: Batch Mates
synergies.text: Synergy BATCH MATES: your 'sibling' might be one of 4,470 other clones. Crew find this oddly moving.

synergies.name: Pharmacy Redistribution
synergies.text: Synergy PHARMACY REDISTRIBUTION: you steal medicine and give it away. Loot heals a little.
